responsibility: This module is the GNU Modula-2 Logitech/PIM compatibility runtime library, providing legacy standard-library facilities expected by older Modula-2 programs rather than core code generation logic. Its files cluster around low-level storage and bit manipulation utilities (the BitBlockOps, BitByteOps, BitWordOps, and BlockOps families), terminal and text I/O layers built from Keyboard, Display, Termbase, Terminal, and the higher-level InOut and typed I/O modules, operating-system facing services such as FileSystem, Break, Delay, ErrorCode, Random, and TimeDate, and language-level data conversion helpers for strings, integers, cardinals, reals, and floating utilities. The module also includes a few empty compatibility stubs such as DebugPMD, DebugTrace, and NumberConversion so legacy imports continue to build. Overall, this directory serves as a Logitech-compatible support library that adapts GNU Modula-2 programs to historical APIs for console interaction, file handling, memory operations, numeric formatting/parsing, timing, and process control.
